iWantTo: run the migration's down path to reconstruct a combined inventory_code from the canonical location plus the split-out batch and serial, restoring the pre-split schema
soThat: the schema change is reversible and we can roll back to the combined-code shape without losing data

independence.rationale: S1 delivers only the forward up-migration and integrity probe; this story adds the down-migration behavior (recombining location + batch + serial back into inventory_code and restoring the old column shape), which S1's forward path does not build and can be failed independently by breaking only the reverse reconstruction.
